svg.title: Four modem gears
svg.desc: Where each modem gear places its tones between 0 and 7 kHz. Wideband2400 uses 12 subbands of 2-of-7 tones from 500 to 6437.5 Hz. Narrowband1200 uses 6 subbands of 3-of-6 tones up to 3062.5 Hz. Robust300 uses 3 subbands of 1-of-4 tones on a 125 Hz grid up to 1875 Hz. Speech300 synthesizes a voice-like waveform with a moving pitch and three formants.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four gears for a channel built for voices

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Speech codecs keep what sounds like a person and squeeze the rest. Each gear puts its tones where they are most likely to survive.
wideband codecs (AMR-WB, EVS): 50 Hz to 7 kHz
